desktop_preview: Muuqaal hordhac ah: matoorka shaandhaynta weli lagama xirin kombiyuutarkan. Badhanku wuxuu kaliya muujinayaa sida barnaamijku u shaqayn doono.
state_on_detail_no_delay: Qalabka muusigga waa laga saaray dhammaan barnaamijyada.
engine_error_no_pactl: Qalabka codka lama helin (pactl). Waaiya waxay u baahan tahay PulseAudio, ama PipeWire oo leh pipewire-pulse.
engine_error_no_sound_server: Server-ka codku ma shaqaynayo (PulseAudio ama PipeWire).
engine_error_no_systemd: Nidaamkan ma laha fadhi isticmaale oo systemd ah, kaas oo shaandhada ka wada gadaal.
engine_error_no_output: Lama helin af-hayeen (speakers) ama sameecado dhegaha.
engine_error_service_failed:
Shaandhadu waxay ku joogsatay khalad. Faahfaahin:
{details}
autostart_body: Shaandhee codka isla marka aad soo gasho kombiyuutarka.
blur_body_desktop: Waxay daboolaysaa dadka iyo sawirrada shaashadda, daaqad kasta dusheeda, inta Waaiya furan tahay (way shaqaysaa haddii shaandhada codku daaran tahay iyo haddii kaleba). Kombiyuutarkan ayay ka shaqaysaa; meelna waxba looma diro. Xiridda daaqadda Waaiya waxay joojisaa qarinta.
blur_fail_body_desktop: Daaran: shaashadda oo dhan waa la daboolaa marka kombiyuutarku aad u gaabis yahay ama qarintu fashilanto; gujintu weli way gaartaa daaqadaha hoose. Damsan: shaashaddu way muuqanaysaa iyadoo xariiq casaan ahi ku jiro korka.
blur_status_on_visible_desktop: Qarintu way daaran tahay. Desktop-kani qarinta wuxuu ku muujiyaa sawir-qaadista shaashaddiisa, sidaas darteed meel la qariyay way qarsoonaanaysaa ilaa muuqaalku isbeddelo.
blur_status_no_capture:
Qarintu ma arki karto shaashadda. Faahfaahin:
{details}
blur_status_no_overlay_desktop:
Qarintu kama muuqan karto daaqadaha kale dushooda desktop-kan. Faahfaahin:
{details}
blur_status_share_dialog: Ka dooro shaashaddaada daaqadda wadaagista shaashadda oo ogolow. Waaiya hal mar oo kaliya ayay weydiisaa; sawirku kombiyuutarkan ayuu ku jiraa.
blur_status_exited:
Qarintu si lama filaan ah ayay u joogsatay. Dami oo dib u daar doorasho qarin si aad mar kale isku daydo. Faahfaahin:
{details}
engine_detector_failed: Aaladda garata heesaha haweenka lama soo shubin, sidaas darteed codadka waa la aamusiiyaa inta doorashadaas daaran tahay.
blur_status_uncovered: Shaashad (monitor) kama daboolna qarinta: lalama wadaagin, ama goor dambe ayaa la galiyay. Dami oo dib u daar doorasho qarin, oo ka dooro shaashad kasta daaqadda wadaagista shaashadda.
blur_status_models_missing_desktop: Moodeelada qarintu kuma jiraan rakibaaddan, sidaas darteed waxba ma dabooli karto; xariiq casaan ah ayaa ku hadhaya korka shaashadda. Dib u rakib Waaiya.
diag_note_desktop: Waxa Waaiya ku aragto kombiyuutarkan. Koobiyee oo sii qofka ku caawinaya. Barnaamijka laftiisu waxba ma diro.
setting_hold_silence_body_desktop: Waa lagu talinayaa. Haddii shaandhayntu iskeed u joogsato (khalad, adiga ma aha), barnaamijyada kale way aamusnaanayaan ilaa aad dib u bilowdo ama aad riixdo Jooji, halkii ay muusig aan la shaandheyn daari lahaayeen.
setting_stereo_body_desktop: Damsan: mono, oo kombiyuutarka ka qaata awood yar. Daaran: wuxuu kala ilaaliyaa dhinaca bidix iyo midig. Haddii kombiyuutarku aad ugu gaabis yahay stereo, iskiis ayuu ugu wareegaa mono.
link_entry_body_desktop: Dhaji link YouTube, TikTok ama Instagram si aad u daawato adigoo shaandhadu daaran tahay, ama si aad u kaydiso muusig la'aan.
link_entry_body_watch: Dhaji link YouTube, TikTok ama Instagram si aad ugu daawato browser-kaaga adigoo shaandhadu daaran tahay.
link_watch_note_desktop: Wuxuu ka furmaa browser-kaaga. Waaiya marka hore ayay bilaabaysaa shaandhada, sidaas darteed muusigga halkaasna waa laga saarayaa.
link_filter_failed: Shaandhadu ma bilaabmin, sidaas darteed link-ga lama furin. Ka bilow bogga Shaandho oo mar kale isku day.
link_singing_note: Heesaha haweenka sidoo kale waa la aamusiiyaa, sida dejintaada.
